title: Shadow Of Depths
description: Adds a bunch of stuff like new blocks, new items, and a new dimension
body:
# Shadow Of Depths This mod was made for a server that I would make called *Shadow Of Depths.*
The mod adds the following blocks: - Darkasite Block - Shadow Block - Darkasite Ore - Magic Block - Enricher - Heater - **Void Heart**
Fluids: - Heated Water
Sounds: - Void Heart Boss Music (not made by me)
Dimensions: - Shadow Realm
Foods: - Strawberry (unobtainable lol) - Banana (unobtainable lol)
Items: - Darkasite - Chisel (turns mainly logs into other types of logs and stone into stone bricks and vice versa) - Refined Darkasite (smelt darkasite) - Enriched Darkasite (put refined darkasite into an enricher) - Combustible Spores (fuel, unobtainable) - Heated Water Bucket - Void Essence
Tools: - Enriched Darkasite Shard - Void Infused Sword - Void Infused Pickaxe
Biomes: - Shadow Realm - Food Haven - Danger Zone - they are unused currently To enter the shadow realm you must apply the effect called Soul Fond (brewed by using heart of the sea) and then die to the void. To acquire void essence, defeat the **Void Heart** Void Heart Boss Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vdYCdbnrl4Q (not mine yes im sorry i dont know how to make music im solo)
